principles: Do not optimize for its own sake; fix only the late-discovery correctness gap from the baseline.
Keep DONE merge authority unchanged and reuse existing done_prepare/main-sync recovery.
Make the signal read-only, advisory, and host-neutral.
Make behavior mechanically testable with focused local smoke coverage.
drivers: The warning must be visible before REVIEW or at REVIEW entry, not only during DONE closure.
Behind-main state must not by itself block REVIEW/TEST or mutate phase.
The smoke must distinguish behind-main, synced, and no-mutation cases.

options.name: shared-readiness-helper
pros: Keeps main-sync calculation consistent across session/lifecycle surfaces.
Allows a small focused smoke to call the helper directly and verify no mutation.
Avoids changing DONE oracle or merge behavior.
cons: Requires modest refactor or export of existing branch divergence logic.

options.name: session-brief-only-warning
cons: Could miss lifecycle_check users and may be harder to prove as a general pre-REVIEW readiness boundary.

options.name: hard-review-gate
pros: Would force users to sync before REVIEW.
cons: Violates the story scope by turning an advisory readiness signal into a blocker.
Could create churn for harmless main metadata changes and arbitrarily optimize process flow.

rationale: Use a shared read-only helper or equivalent shared code path so the same branch-behind-main signal can be surfaced before REVIEW and covered by focused tests, while preserving DONE merge behavior and non-blocking semantics.

preMortem.scenario: The implementation only reuses the existing DONE closure row.
preMortem.trigger: The warning is visible only in done_closure/session TEST DONE pre-check.
preMortem.consequence: Baseline item 4 remains unfixed because late discovery still happens.
preMortem.mitigation: Smoke must exercise a pre-REVIEW or REVIEW-entry read-only surface and fail if only DONE closure has the row.

preMortem.scenario: The implementation adds a hard REVIEW/TEST blocker.
preMortem.trigger: story_advance REVIEW or TEST fails solely because main moved.
preMortem.consequence: The story violates the non-blocking advisory scope and creates arbitrary process friction.
preMortem.mitigation: Smoke asserts no phase mutation or gate failure solely from behind-main readiness.

preMortem.scenario: The helper mutates git state while checking readiness.
preMortem.trigger: The readiness surface runs merge or writes metadata.
preMortem.consequence: A read-only command becomes unsafe and can invalidate evidence.
preMortem.mitigation: Smoke snapshots HEAD/phase before and after readiness checks.
